picks.name: Summer Drum Circle
picks.description: A free community drum circle under the trees at The Shack at Sellwood Park. Bring your own percussion, a blanket, and your best rhythm — or just come to listen and soak up the summer vibes. All ages welcome.

picks.name: Open Play Swim
picks.description: Portland Parks & Rec opens Creston Pool for free open-play swim on Monday evenings. Cool off in the water without spending a dime — Use our public resources. It helps them get funding going forward too!

picks.name: Thrifty Tuesday
picks.description: The beloved Portland movie house drops admission to $7 every Tuesday. Catch indie hits and Hollywood classics in a neighborhood theater with a bar and great programming. Most theaters do discounted tickets on Tuesday, check out the one closest to you!

picks.name: PFCAT Film Festival
picks.description: Portland's Festival of Cinema, Animation & Technology kicks off at OMSI with screenings, short films, and programming exploring the intersection of art, technology, and moving images. A local indie film event worth catching.

picks.name: Clay Commons Ceramic Market
picks.description: Clay Commons brings local ceramicists to Director Park in the heart of downtown. Browse handmade cups, bowls, vases, and sculpture from the region's best potters. Free to attend — and a great chance to find your new favorite mug.

picks.name: Duckworth Wednesdays
picks.description: The Lloyd District's regular Wednesday evening hang — Live music, incredible sunsets, and great vibes. Bring some snacks or bevies and make it an evening.

picks.name: Sunflower U-Pick
picks.description: Bella Organic's annual Sunflower Festival is in full swing on Sauvie Island — u-cut sunflowers by the armful, cow train rides, a full farm store, and wine and cider tasting. An easy 20-minute drive from Portland for a proper summer farm day.

picks.name: Concert in the Park: Ants! Ants! Ants!
picks.description: Portland Parks & Rec brings another free summer concert to Grant Park, featuring Ants Ants Ants. Pack a blanket and some snacks and settle in as the evening cools down — Kids' music inspired by the melodies of the 1970s, from The Beatles to Schoolhouse Rock.

picks.name: MADE Bike Show
picks.description: Portland's premier handbuilt bicycle showcase returns to Zidell Yards along the South Waterfront. Framebuilders and small manufacturers from across the country display one-of-a-kind road, mountain, and cargo bikes. Runs Fri–Sun. A must for bike nerds.

picks.name: Secret Roller Disco
picks.description: Portland's beloved weekly roller disco rotates to a new secret location each time — follow @secretrollerdisco for the Friday reveal. Free to skate, BYOS or rent a pair. Pure Portland weird in the very best way.

picks.name: Smile Boat Parade
picks.description: Decorated boats parade through North Portland Harbor celebrating community and summer on the water. Grab a spot along the shore at 1611 NE Marine Drive and wave from the bank as the flotilla rolls through. Free and family-friendly.

picks.name: Movie in the Park: Cool Runnings
picks.description: Portland Parks & Rec's Summer Free for All screens Cool Runnings in Sewallcrest Park. The beloved underdog classic about Jamaica's Olympic bobsled team holds up completely. Bring a blanket, your neighbors, and maybe a winter hat for irony.

picks.name: Hawthorne Street Fair
picks.description: Hawthorne Boulevard transforms into a pedestrian festival of local vendors, food carts, live music, and neighborhood energy. One of Portland's most beloved summer street fairs — free, walkable, and the perfect way to close out the week.

picks.name: Paint Fight!
picks.description: Speed painting competition at The High Water Mark in Portland. Watch as talented artists create beautiful or quirky pieces in a short time.
